name: Using the Thunderkeg gives 5 Thunderale of the clicker's rank (#10281, #10880)
contract: Conjure Thunderkeg (807849) places Thunderkeg, gameobject 195002 (GAMEOBJECT_TYPE_SPELLCASTER). Its tooltip: 'Players in your party or raid may interact with it to receive $807850s1 tankards of Thunderale.' Data0 is 807850 (Conjure Thunderale: CREATE_ITEM, 5 items) and Data2 (party only) is 1. The item follows the ranked Conjure Thunder Ale ladder (804763 -> 2000150, 808068 -> 2000400, 808069 -> 2000401 at level 22, 808073 -> 2000405 at level 60): a script on 807850 gives the highest rank whose required level the clicker has reached, instead of the fixed rank 1 Weak Thunder Ale (#10880). Level 60 receives Cask-Strength Thunder Ale (2000405); after dropping to level 30 the same keg gives 2000401 (rank at level 22).
